# Apt packages Tauri 2 requires on Linux, mirroring Tauri's prerequisites doc.
# tauri-runtime-wry's build script links against WebKitGTK during dependency
# compilation, so these are needed even for `cargo check`, not just for a build.
#
# This list lives in its own file so the CI apt cache key can hash it. Editing
# it invalidates that cache, which is the point: an entry must never outlive the
# package set it was built from.
libwebkit2gtk-4.1-dev
build-essential
curl
wget
file
libxdo-dev
libssl-dev
libayatana-appindicator3-dev
librsvg2-dev
